fields.davesch\n\n 2018-11-26 21:25\n\ndevelope:
Using any variation of "Step..." should be reserved for a child born to one of the parents but not adopted by the new spouse. The same for "Half-" siblings.

Legally, the relationship would be the same as if they where born into the family. So Father, mother, sister, brother. The "Relation within this family (if not by birth)" showing adopted makes it clear that the parents are not the birth parents.

Father, Mother, Sister, Brother, Sibling would be my first choice. But I also know there are some that see genealogy as biological and may have problems with these titles.

Second option would be Adoptive Father, Adoptive Mother as the case may be, leaving Sister, Brother for siblings. I am not adverse to adding the Adoptive qualifier to the sibling titles. These would at least be accurate.
